decisions.rationale: duplicate_row_rate 0.011188 over row_count 45228 means roughly 506 rows repeat an identical business payload; after the Airbyte metadata columns are dropped the remaining business columns are compared and exact duplicates are collapsed to one row.

invoice (2330 distinct, null_rate 0.0) and stockcode (3141 distinct, null_rate 0.0) are the smallest fully populated pair that plausibly identifies one order line after exact duplicates are removed; a reviewer must measure it against the warehouse because the profile offers no combination-level uniqueness evidence and a repeated stockcode on one invoice would break it.

_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at and _airbyte_meta all carry is_airbyte_metadata true; their values (per-row UUIDs, two load timestamps, constant '{}') describe the capture run, not the retail transaction.
customer_id has null_count 13468 of 45228 (null_rate 0.29778), a large but legitimate share of guest or unattributed transactions, so nulls are retained and the column is not part of the grain.
quantity lands as DECIMAL(38,9) but min -1395.0, max 5184.0 and every sample_value is integral, so INTEGER is the faithful target type.
price lands as DECIMAL(38,9) with min 0.0, max 1998.49 and sample_values at two decimal places or fewer, so DECIMAL(10,2) preserves every observed value at currency precision.

invoicedate is VARCHAR with null_rate 0.0 and all 10 sample_values in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' form, so a TIMESTAMP cast is supported; the column is also renamed to invoice_date for snake_case consistency.

invoice samples are numeric strings but only 10 of 2330 distinct values were sampled, so the evidence does not cover every value and the column stays VARCHAR rather than risking a failed integer cast.

quantity min is -1395.0 and all ten sample_values are negative, so negative quantities exist in volume; is_return_line surfaces them as a boolean instead of forcing consumers to rediscover the sign convention.

description sample_values show leading and trailing spaces (' 3 STRIPEY MICE FELTCRAFT', ' BROWN  PIRATE TREASURE CHEST ') and mixed casing (' Bank Charges'); trimming or case folding would change 3045 distinct values and is left to a reviewer rather than assumed here.
price min is 0.0, so zero-value lines exist in bronze; they are retained unchanged because the profile gives no evidence that zero means missing.

purpose: silver_online_retail_ii is the cleaned, typed line-item table for the online retail transaction feed landed in bronze.online_retail_ii: one row per invoiced product line, with capture-tool columns removed, numeric and timestamp columns cast from their landed text and DECIMAL(38,9) forms, and exact duplicate rows collapsed. It feeds downstream revenue, basket, and customer-level aggregates.
usage: Read one row as one invoice line: multiply quantity by price for line value. Returns and cancellations are present in the same table and carry negative quantity; filter on is_return_line deliberately, either excluding it for gross sales or keeping it for net figures. customer_id is null on roughly 30 percent of rows, so any customer-level aggregate must filter nulls explicitly rather than relying on a join to silently drop them. invoice_date is a timestamp in the source's local clock as landed; country is the free-text country label, not an ISO code.
limitations: The declared grain of invoice plus stockcode is a proposal, not a measured fact: the profile reports per-column distinct counts only, so a reviewer must confirm no invoice repeats a stockcode before the uniqueness rule is approved. Exact duplicate removal addresses the 0.011188 duplicate_row_rate but cannot distinguish a true repeated line from a double-landed row. description is retained as landed, with untrimmed whitespace and mixed casing visible in the samples, and 228 nulls (null_rate 0.005041) are kept rather than filled. customer_id is sparsely populated at null_rate 0.29778. Zero-price lines (price min 0.0) and negative quantities (quantity min -1395.0) are retained, not corrected, and invoice is kept as text because only 10 of its 2330 distinct values were sampled.
